artifacts.contract: Bounded conditional LIFO cleanup, explicit no-reentry/no-nonlocal-exit callbacks, and transactional publish-by-swap; no implicit C unwinding.
Strong/weak control and value lifetimes, bounded count overflow, non-atomic and C17 atomic protocols with owned-reference preconditions; no pointee synchronization or cycle collection guarantee.
V4Allocator typed callback adapter with deterministic fail-at-N, finite counters, poison and live/peak accounting; real int32_t backing objects and explicit observer limits.

PR-T66-04.question: Should the component dynamically track range loans or rely on a whole-object ownership protocol?
alternatives: single exclusive owner with documented temporary borrows
PR-T66-04.discriminator: A split writer and two disjoint mutable views must be admitted while an overlapping reader is rejected; compare metadata, checks and exhaustion behavior under that same contract.
PR-T66-04.reversal_trigger: The client no longer requires disjoint simultaneous mutation, or the guard registry cost exceeds the declared bound.
